pillars.title: Sony BIONZ XR ARM Trusted Firmware (BL2/BL31/OP-TEE), WBI2/hibdrv & fwtool/PMCA

findings.technical_facts: 48 KiB BootROM at 0xFFFF0000..0xFFFFBFFF; watchdog >= 0xFFFFC000; SRAM fastboot loader 0x92028000 / 0xFE020000 (18D1:4EE0); Multi-Port 48000 baud open-drain UART; SDM2 AES-XTS-256 encryption.
findings.disclosure_gap: Proprietary Sony BL2/BL31/OP-TEE binaries remain without complete public disassembly; no unauthenticated SW cold-boot RoT bypass published.
findings.lab_alignment: Phase 42 verifies WBI2, p1, p2, p8 dumps strictly O_RDONLY and relies on volatile tmpfs RAM-overlay execution leaving nflasha1..nflasha8 untouched.

findings.topic: Standard TF-A Boot Architecture (BL1 -> BL2 -> BL31 -> OP-TEE BL32 -> Linux)
findings.technical_facts: Defines EL3 BL31 Secure Monitor and OP-TEE BL32 Secure OS boundary separating Normal World Linux from crypto/RPMB key storage.
findings.lab_alignment: Boot-Chain Immutability Firewall blocks targeting of BOOT0, BOOT1, RPMB, loader_nor, and nflasha1..nflasha8.

findings.topic: WBI2 / hibdrv Hibernation Snapshot vs Cold Boot
findings.source: Erlla/sony-a7m4-custom-firmware & fail0verflow Lineo Warp!! hibdrv analysis
findings.technical_facts: 88B WBI2 header (<4sI10Q), 64B section descriptors (<8Q) protected by 0x0F0F0F0F XOR metadata checksum; community installers overwrite WBI2 -> wbi2/WBI3 in nflasha5 to force cold boot.
findings.lab_alignment: verify_p5_wbi2_dump() validates header, XOR descriptors, and resume vector coverage while detecting invalidated wbi2/WBI3 headers without modifying nflasha5.

findings.technical_facts: macOS IOUSBHost 0xe00002be (kIOReturnExclusiveAccess) mitigation and Senser v2 RSA challenge enforcement on ILCE-7M5 / newer bodies.
findings.lab_alignment: Implemented in fx3_recovery/macos_usb_transport_guard.py (fail-closed rejection of Senser v2 and destructive Jiritsu commands).

pillars.title: eMMC ISP Forensics, EXT_CSD PART_CONFIG 0xB3, CMD42 Hazards & Multi-Port 48000 UART

findings.technical_facts: EXT_CSD[179]: bit6 BOOT_ACK, bits[5:3] BOOT_PARTITION_ENABLE (0=disabled brick risk, 1=BOOT0, 2=BOOT1, 7=UDA), bits[2:0] PARTITION_ACCESS (0=UDA, 1=BOOT0, 2=BOOT1, 3=RPMB); EXT_CSD[267..269] EOL/wear.
findings.lab_alignment: verify_ext_csd_dump() flags disabled boot enable, reserved bit7, un-reset PARTITION_ACCESS, and NAND pre-EOL wear warnings.

findings.source: Hugget, Souvignet, Heckmann, Naccache — FSI: Digital Investigation 57:302109 (June 2026)
findings.technical_facts: Timing side-channels failed under tested conditions while voltage fault injection bypassed CMD42 password verification on 5/10 tested eMMC devices; CMD42 Forced Erase destroys UDA.
findings.lab_alignment: audit_boot_chain_immutability() strictly prohibits cmd42_lock, cmd42_set_pwd, and cmd42_force_erase operations.

findings.topic: Stuck-Bus SPI/SDMMC ISP Read Anomaly Detection & Two-Pass Hashing
findings.source: DFIR Flash / eMMC ISP Best Practices + Oberli DEF CON 27
findings.technical_facts: Floating DAT0 pull-ups produce >=16 contiguous 0xFF pages; shorted power/ground produces all-0x00 or constant fills; bus noise causes bit-flips across reads.
findings.lab_alignment: analyze_bus_and_entropy() + read_two_pass_sha256_readonly() enforce O_RDONLY | O_NOFOLLOW | O_NONBLOCK two-pass SHA-256 and Shannon entropy floors.

findings.technical_facts: Multi-Port UART initializes at 48000 baud open-drain; RP2040-Zero -DOPEN_DRAIN avoids standard Raspberry Pi Pico GP29 VSYS/3 divider hazard before Fastboot 18D1:4EE0.
findings.lab_alignment: Documented as mandatory bench wiring constraint for read-only UART telemetry capture.

pillars.title: QEMU ARM64 + ARM32 Camera Firmware Co-Emulation Comparison

comparisons.gap_vs_our_lab: Single-vendor monolithic MMIO patches; our lab decouples AArch64 AP and unmodified ARMv7-R cpapp-b.bin cleanly via ivshmem.
Good multi-SoC table inspiration, but single-OS focus without dual-core RTOS CP co-emulation or ramfb OSD.
Our Phase 24/29/33 native shared-memory ivshmem avoids Python MMIO forwarding latency while preparing for QMP HIL.
Phases 29 and 33 already subsume ramfb + virtual-rom-v1 BT H4 and extend to Phase 24 dual-CPU CP RTOS co-emulation.

comparisons.project: Our Lab Phases 24 / 29 / 33 (+ Parallel Phase 41 PCIe/DTB)
comparisons.architecture: fx3-vm Dual-AP+CP ivshmem (22 tests) + Soft GPE/BT (25 tests) + Unified Suite (71 tests total)
comparisons.gap_vs_our_lab: Phase 41 branch (codex/h33-phase41-qemu-pcie-bar-mailbox-dtb) remains parallel/unmerged; Phase 42 Tier-4 forensic verifier gates all dumps entering VM & H0 workflows.
